summary: Added audit=1 to the kernel boot parameters on node1 via grubby (updated all grub2 boot entries) and synced /etc/default/grub for future grub2-mkconfig regenerations. Verified persistence across an actual reboot: boot_id changed, /proc/cmdline shows audit=1, and dmesg confirms the kernel audit subsystem initialized.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: RHEL7.9, BIOS/grub2 boot, grubby present, original cmdline lacked audit=1, boot_id=2fc81aed...
Ran sudo grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1" to add the parameter to all boot entries (main + rescue kernel)
Updated /etc/default/grub GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX to append audit=1 for consistency with future grub2-mkconfig runs
Verified /boot/grub2/grub.cfg menuentries now include audit=1 on the linux16 lines
Captured pre-reboot boot_id as baseline boot identity
Issued a backgrounded/delayed systemctl reboot so the exec acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec was available again; observed connection timeout during reboot window then successful reconnection
Verified boot_id changed (2fc81aed... -> 6967ac42...), proving an actual restart occurred
Verified post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1 and dmesg shows 'audit: enabled (after initialization)' confirming the kernel setting took effect and persisted

evidence.requirement: Baseline: original cmdline lacks audit=1, healthy boot identity captured
evidence.summary: Pre-change /proc/cmdline had no audit=1; boot_id 2fc81aed-3ce8-4a35-8f4c-b73206afa45f recorded as baseline boot identity

evidence.requirement: Kernel parameter audit=1 added persistently via grubby to all boot entries
evidence.summary: grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=audit=1 succeeded; grubby --info=ALL shows audit=1 appended to args for both the main and rescue kernel entries

evidence.requirement: Persistence mechanism confirmed in grub.cfg and defaults
evidence.summary: /etc/default/grub GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX updated to include audit=1; grep of /boot/grub2/grub.cfg confirms audit=1 present on linux16 lines for boot entries

evidence.requirement: Reboot acknowledgement returns before disconnection (safe reboot mechanism)
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued via backgrounded delayed shell; exec call returned ACK_RETURNED immediately, before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node restart actually occurred (changed boot identity, not just elapsed time)
evidence.summary: First poll still showed old boot_id/cmdline (reboot pending); next poll timed out (node down mid-reboot); final poll succeeded with new boot_id 6967ac42-9c01-4a8c-ab56-54a8624acb5e, proving a genuine restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart proof that audit=1 took effect on the running kernel
evidence.summary: Post-reboot /proc/cmdline includes audit=1; dmesg shows 'audit: enabled (after initialization)' and audit netlink socket initialization, confirming the kernel parameter was applied and the audit subsystem is active
